description: The household shopping list and recipe book.
_comment_colours: theme_color is absent on purpose. Setting it pins the status bar to ONE colour in both light and dark (v9.1-v9.4, and the green in the Phase 3 build); leaving it out lets the bar follow the phone, white or black, which is what we want. Chrome ignores <meta name=theme-color> in an installed app, and color_scheme_dark is not implemented yet - both measured, see git history. background_color only tints the launch splash and is the blue seed's light surface (#f9f9ff), since a manifest cannot read CSS variables.
